name: No Flowers in Arizona ~Rust-Red Vivarium~
source:
Mirasol has been living with Dolores for as long as she remembers. Dolores has cared for Mirasol ever since a tragic accident impeded Mirasol's ability to live on her own.
Dolores is all Mirasol knows, and Mirasol is a weight that Dolores cannot shed. 

[From [url=https://sacredruin.itch.io/no-flowers-in-arizona-rust-red-vivarium]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自记事起，米拉索尔便一直与多洛雷斯相依为命。自从一场惨痛的意外夺走了米拉索尔独立生活的能力，多洛雷斯便一直悉心照料着她。
多洛雷斯是米拉索尔所知的全部世界，而米拉索尔则是多洛雷斯永远无法卸下的重担。

[摘自[url=https://sacredruin.itch.io/no-flowers-in-arizona-rust-red-vivarium]itch.io[/url]]
